For owner review · November 4, 2026

Ad creative kit, David's Barber Shop.

Google Search ads, extensions and Meta ads, each matched to the page it sends people to. Nothing here is live and no money is being spent. Every ad is on hold until the items below are settled. Please read each ad and tell us what is wrong or not accurate.

What we need from you

  • Opening hours — settled. The hours on your Google listing are the right ones: Monday to Friday 8:30am–7pm, closed Saturdays, Sunday 9am–6pm. The site and these ads use them. Booksy still says Monday and Friday from 9am, Tuesday to Thursday from 9:30am and Friday until 4:30pm; please change Booksy to match so clients can book the same times online.
  • Barbers — settled. You confirmed Michael, Russel and Alex are the barbers. The site now shows them, and David and Sean are off the site. Russel and Alex have no services on Booksy yet, so clients cannot book them online; please add their services in Booksy. Photos and a few lines about each barber would make their pages stronger.
  • Prices — settled. You confirmed Booksy's menu. The site, landing pages and these ads now use it: Haircut $35, Haircut & beard $55, Line up $20, Beard $20, Beard trim $20. The shave ad is retired because Booksy has no shave.
  • FOX 5. Is "As seen on FOX 5 Good Day New York" accurate to say? It is off everywhere until you confirm. It would appear as words only, never the FOX logo.
  • Walk-ins. The window says "Walk-ins welcome". Is that still true? Then we can use it in the ads.
  • People in the photos. Two photos show a barber and clients. Did they agree to appear in ads? We also need the original, full-size photos, because the copies we have are small.
  • Price comparisons. No ad compares our prices with other shops. That stays off unless you approve it.

Never in any ad: player or celebrity names or photos, photos other people posted to the Google listing, star ratings.
